component.name: MCRS Launcher
component.summary: Play Horizon and build native Minecraft mods

description.p: A lightweight native Rust desktop launcher for Horizon, the Rust implementation of Minecraft.

ul.li: Play a prepared game as Guest or a saved offline profile, with optional Microsoft sign-in for authenticated servers.
Install current Horizon builds and check for updates.
Import native Horizon mods from GitHub and compile them inside the sandbox.

description.p: Native mod builds use the Freedesktop SDK runtime's compiler and development libraries. The initial setup downloads Horizon and its required game resources.
Unofficial software. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. Minecraft assets are not included.
Add an account menu, saved offline profiles, and Guest play without required Microsoft sign-in.
Publish the account changes as a versioned release for the signed Flatpak update repository.
Use all available CPU cores for native mod compilation by default, while preserving explicit CARGO_BUILD_JOBS limits.
Add offline play, configurable automatic Horizon update checks, and launcher updates for native installations.

Retry engine downloads through GitHub's release-asset API when the normal download endpoint returns a gateway error, and let Play continue with the verified installed build when an update cannot be downloaded.
Resize down to 480 by 360 with compact navigation, stacked cards, wrapping controls and resizable dialogs.
Retry temporary GitHub failures, show update unavailability without a fatal error, and let Play use a verified prepared build when the update check fails.
Prepare the exact Horizon version before native mod compilation, keep rebuilds on their existing revision, and respect the selected update channel.
Resume Minecraft preparation automatically after temporary DNS and connection failures, preserving completed downloads and cancellation.
Smooth preparation activity animation, with low-frequency updates when no animation is needed.
Download progress with speed and ETA, game-folder shortcuts, real player heads and Minecraft skin uploads.
